verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a draft-versus-published model inside a single flow, plus an approval gate for publishing in Sensitive projects. Neither is source-control (Git) versioning, nor separate dev/production environments with a promotion path. That makes them adjacent publishing controls, not the capability this story asks for. Nothing in the pack documents Git sync, flow export/import between environments, or environment promotion.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
